latest_release.body:
## [3.10.1](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/compare/v3.10.0...v3.10.1) (2026-11-13)


### Bug Fixes

* **🌐:** don't throw from a draw when the context can't make a surface ([#4440](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4440)) ([ebacceb](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/commit/ebaccebb63386d2ce20a518c881174864af87806))
* **🌐:** keep the frame of a disposed canvas that is still on screen ([#4438](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4438)) ([38ae704](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/commit/38ae7040ff06e02438eed05e5f4ca9f8ab468e3c))
* **🎨:** draw a node's own paint first, then its <Paint> children, as the JS player does ([#4450](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4450)) ([0a736db](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/commit/0a736db1d10f71ff298e63faca65350a31de7e4d))
* **🏎️:** fix race condition in the render thread- [#4453](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4453) ([#4453](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4453)) ([914fae1](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/commit/914fae19683edbce527bbafd0bea6d649660df0a))
* **🤖:** follow display density changes on Android ([#4448](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4448)) ([da8e112](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/commit/da8e112aa25f5b85ce9169918e5f583a57bbb1a1))
* **🧠:** trim a render thread again once it goes idle after a busy trim ([#4347](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4347)) ([2c0f324](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/commit/2c0f32410c7ef1b0d07224b8b753f0d1b4cc15f3))
* show an opaque TextureView canvas under a rotated, rounded clip on Android 10 ([#4228](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/issues/4228)) ([2087e16](https://github.com/wcandillon/react-native-skia/commit/2087e16c15c66c315c199d8b201750485f98ecbf))
